construction: 80 parts in 24 steps plus six children. Steps 4 and 7: 1×1 headlight bricks. Step 6: 1×1 bricks with studs on two adjacent sides. Step 9: a core child inside the head. Step 12: a flat sand-green plate-and-tile child panel mounted sideways as the side of the head. Steps 15 and 18: the ear children. Steps 16 and 19: the hand children. Step 23: the 6×6 base plate.
interfaces: Stud directions: 80 parts, 41 up, 12 −Z, 9 each +X, −X and +Z.
lesson: BrickHeadz faces use a side-stud core plus flat panels built separately and turned.
parent_context: Yoda in `41627 - Yoda and Luke Skywalker.ldr`, rotated 180° about Y.
reuse_notes: Build each head side as a flat child and turn it; the face and side panels stay independent.
